title: Quick Sour Croatian Porridge Oats Hash
description: A sour, crispy, one-pot dish from Croatia featuring porridge oats, bonito flakes, and a macrobiotic-friendly twist. Serve hot in a claypot.

ingredients.name: bonito flakes
ingredients.notes: dried and toasted for added umami flavor

instructions: Combine oats, yeast, and water in a claypot. Mix well and let it sit for 10 minutes to allow the oats to absorb the water.
Add apple cider vinegar, bonito flakes, sesame oil, salt, and pepper to the claypot. Mix well to combine.
Place the claypot over medium heat and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, stirring frequently, until the oats are cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Serve the Quick Sour Croatian Porridge Oats Hash hot in the claypot, garnished with additional bonito flakes if desired.
Be cautious when handling hot claypot and utensils.
Allow the hash to cool completely before refrigerating or freezing it for later use.
When reheating, add a splash of water or broth to the hash to maintain its moisture and texture.
To enhance the flavor, add a squeeze of fresh lemon juice or a drizzle of olive oil before serving.
Experiment with different seasonings and spices to make the Quick Sour Croatian Porridge Oats Hash your own.
